summary: Georgia Power filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) under Rule 424(b)(5) registered on Form 333-285111 for a public offering of Series 2026A Floating Rate Senior Notes. The notes are unsecured, unsubordinated obligations, pay compounded SOFR plus a spread quarterly, and are redeemable at 101% upon a Tax Credit Event. The offering is part of concurrent note issuances but not contingent on them. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. No special-situation event is present; the filing is an ordinary shelf takedown.
